note: The same six pause-menu cycles with EDEN_NX2_AREA_EVICT_BURST=300 (default 100): the area clean-up (patch 0274, EDEN_NX2_AREA_EVICT=40 in the play env) reads a burst of 100 new images in 30 frames as an area load and then deletes what was unused for 40 frames. Opening the pause menu makes 102-212 new images, so it fires and the whole field goes (772 and 492 images in two logs); real area loads make 419-1962. At 300 the menu should no longer fire it. Wanted: no EDEN_AREA_EVICT burst line at menu open, no rebuild burst at menu close, steadier free memory per cycle than m1. owner's own question: 'the pictures should not be thrown away with pressing start then?'
